Additionally, with the recent increase in residential deliveries, parking spaces that are marked for daylighting may often be occupied by delivery vehicles, which can negatively impact visibility.

versions.request: Other expense budget request for NYCHA
versions.explanation: Establish a dedicated NYCHA unit to coordinate with the Department of Buildings on Facade Inspection Safety Program (FISP) compliance. The unit would oversee timely facade repairs and the removal of long-standing sidewalk sheds at the Fulton and Elliott-Chelsea Houses and other NYCHA sites in Community District 4. This request aims to end the cycle of permanent scaffolding caused by delayed repairs, improve safety, and ensure transparent, coordinated action across agencies.
versions.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency supports but cannot accommodate Explanation: The Scaffolding at your locations is up due to Local Law 11, which mandates scaffolding when there are issues with facade brickwork to protect pedestrians from falling masonry. Unfortunately, facade work is currently not funded for repair so we are unable to give an estimate on when the scaffolding will be removed. The rest of this request should go to the Department of Buildings.
